sources.title: GitHub - space-bacon/SRT-Sunstone
sources.snippet: Meaning forks. SRT sees it. SRT-Adapter is a lightweight module that bolts semiotic awareness onto any frozen causal language model. The backbone runs natively — its own embeddings, its own LM head, its own attention. SRT modules are small taps that read divergence from hidden states, track reflexive awareness, and optionally inject semiotic corrections back into the stream.
